explanation.en: “snapping shrimp produce a constant crackling sound” → snapping shrimp. The fish in the same sentence “grunt and click” instead.
explanation.kk: «snapping shrimp produce a constant crackling sound» → snapping shrimp. Сол сөйлемдегі балықтар шытырламайды, «grunt and click» дыбыс шығарады.
explanation.ru: «snapping shrimp produce a constant crackling sound» → snapping shrimp. Рыбы в том же предложении «grunt and click», а не трещат.

RT-AC-SA-M-Q1.quote: snapping shrimp produce a constant crackling sound

explanation.en: “drift in the open ocean for several weeks” → several weeks. The six weeks in D is the length of the experiment.
explanation.kk: «drift in the open ocean for several weeks» → several weeks. D абзацындағы six weeks — тәжірибе мерзімі.
explanation.ru: «drift in the open ocean for several weeks» → several weeks. Six weeks из абзаца D — срок эксперимента.

RT-AC-SA-M-Q2.quote: drift in the open ocean for several weeks

explanation.en: “they are guided partly by sound” → sound. The question already has “partly”, so the answer is one word.
explanation.kk: «they are guided partly by sound» → sound. Сұрақ «partly» сөзін қайталайды, сондықтан жауап бір сөз.
explanation.ru: «they are guided partly by sound» → sound. Вопрос повторяет «partly», так что в ответ идёт одно слово.

RT-AC-SA-M-Q3.quote: they are guided partly by sound

explanation.en: The year the damaged reefs were recorded: “In 2017, a team … recorded reefs”. The other numbers in the text are weeks, not years → 2017.
explanation.kk: Зақымдалған рифтерді жазған жыл: «In 2017, a team … recorded reefs». Мәтіндегі басқа сандар — жыл емес, апта → 2017.
explanation.ru: Год записи повреждённых рифов: «In 2017, a team … recorded reefs». Остальные числа в тексте — недели, а не годы → 2017.

RT-AC-SA-M-Q4.quote: In 2017, a team working off the coast of northern Australia recorded reefs

explanation.en: “had lost most of their coral after a heatwave” → heatwave (or a heatwave).
explanation.kk: «had lost most of their coral after a heatwave» → heatwave (немесе a heatwave) — маржанды жойған оқиға.
explanation.ru: «had lost most of their coral after a heatwave» → heatwave (или a heatwave).

RT-AC-SA-M-Q5.quote: reefs that had lost most of their coral after a heatwave

explanation.en: “They placed underwater loudspeakers on patches of dead coral” → underwater loudspeakers (“loudspeakers” is also accepted).
explanation.kk: «They placed underwater loudspeakers on patches of dead coral» → underwater loudspeakers (loudspeakers да есептеледі).
explanation.ru: «They placed underwater loudspeakers on patches of dead coral» → underwater loudspeakers (засчитывается и loudspeakers).

RT-AC-SA-M-Q6.quote: They placed underwater loudspeakers on patches of dead coral

explanation.en: “played recordings of healthy reefs for six weeks” → six weeks. “Several weeks” in B is the larvae drifting.
explanation.kk: «played recordings of healthy reefs for six weeks» → six weeks. B абзацындағы «several weeks» — дернәсілдердің ағыспен жүзуі.
explanation.ru: «played recordings of healthy reefs for six weeks» → six weeks. «Several weeks» из абзаца B — дрейф личинок.

RT-AC-SA-M-Q7.quote: played recordings of healthy reefs for six weeks

explanation.en: Patches with sound attracted twice as many fish as “silent patches nearby” → silent patches (“silent” is also accepted).
explanation.kk: Дыбысы бар учаскелер «silent patches nearby» учаскелерінен екі есе көп балық тартқан → silent patches (silent да есептеледі).
explanation.ru: Участки со звуком привлекли вдвое больше рыб, чем «silent patches nearby» → silent patches (засчитывается и silent).

RT-AC-SA-M-Q8.quote: These patches attracted twice as many young fish as silent patches nearby

explanation.en: “will not stay unless there is food and shelter” → shelter. Food is excluded by “Apart from food”.
explanation.kk: «will not stay unless there is food and shelter» → shelter. Тамақты «Apart from food» деген сөз алып тастайды.
explanation.ru: «will not stay unless there is food and shelter» → shelter. Еда исключена словами «Apart from food».

RT-AC-SA-M-Q9.quote: Young fish will not stay unless there is food and shelter

explanation.en: “will only recover if water temperatures remain stable” → water temperatures, plural as in the text.
explanation.kk: «will only recover if water temperatures remain stable» → water temperatures, мәтіндегідей көпше түрде.
explanation.ru: «will only recover if water temperatures remain stable» → water temperatures, во множественном числе, как в тексте.

RT-AC-SA-M-Q10.quote: the coral itself will only recover if water temperatures remain stable
